title: Paul's Way
about: Paul's way of teaching through trust, responsibility, and letting people learn by doing.
description: This track remembers how Paul treated me differently while I was working with an injury. While others understandably worried and tried to protect me, Paul trusted me to know my limits, use my head, and keep doing the work I was capable of doing. Lights, cables, Ethernet, building, and other real jobs still came my way. Looking back, that quiet trust became one of the most important lessons he gave me: confidence grows when someone gives you the responsibility to think, try, and prove what you can do.

Lyrics: Told me, "Slow down, know your place."
Like I'd break if I touched a mat.
Trying hard to help me through.
I knew they cared, I always will,
They just saw a steeper hill.
Then Paul looked my way and said,
Trust you till you prove him wrong.
Learn by doing, get it done,
He won't stop every crazy plan,
If you've earned it, he'll step aside.
Lights and cables, cords to run,
There was still a job to be done.
Real work still got handed down.
Not because I had to prove,
Because he knew what I could do.
Trust you till you prove him wrong.
Learn by doing, get it done,
He won't stop every crazy plan,
If you've earned it, he'll step aside.
Some teach fear of making mistakes.
Some teach rules you never break.
Years have come and years have gone.
I've worked beside him ever since,
What that quiet trust meant to me.
Not every lesson comes from words.
